content: {"paper_id":"lab-2c640db3fd61","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Complementary label learning (CLL) is a weakly supervised learning paradigm that constructs a multi-class classifier only with complementary labels, specifying classes that the instance does not belong to.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确将CLL定义为弱监督学习范式，仅用互补标签（指定不属于的类）训练多类分类器，监督不完整，满足弱监督设定。"},{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","exact_quote":"For highly-confident instances, we perform PLG to assign them pseudo labels for supervised training.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要明确对高置信样本用PLG分配伪标签并进行监督训练，且涉及迭代使用增强互补标签训练，满足以模型预测作为后续训练信号的定义。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
